nodes.body: { 🎮 Game Demos } Try out the first Alpha Playtest for _BluSurfaceMedia's_ [Plunderer's Run](https://blusurfacemedia.itch.io/plunderers-run/devlog/1641452/the-withertide-awaits-try-the-alpha-playtest-now) and give them feedback!

{!header} August was packed with all kinds of events, from the [Missouri History Museum's Game Night ](https://www.instagram.com/p/Dbv09kekfEs/?img_index=1)that had 400 attendees, to our monthly social (this time at [Boco Boba](https://www.instagram.com/p/DcB6nYfkW2G/?img_index=1)!), to having a [Share and Play](https://www.instagram.com/p/DcqsfWhESaM/?img_index=1) with over 50 devs! It's a great time to be involved in our community, jump in if you haven't already!

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Tony Wojnar_ has been hard at work getting things ready for the [Chicago Indie Game Showcase](https://www.indiecitygames.org/calendar/cigs-2026) with Dribble 2, and has been working on [level design](https://bsky.app/profile/tonywojnar.bsky.social/post/3mt4vcpynyc2k) for the Glitch Ditch level!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _BluSurfaceMedia_ posted a [devlog for Plunderer's Run](https://blusurfacemedia.itch.io/plunderers-run/devlog/1616117/july-2026-modular-cards-and-synergies)!

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _James C. Kane_ posted a [gel, water & sand simulation](https://x.com/jamesckane/status/2084390370771656807) running on Apple Vision Pro WebXR + WebGPU and is also experimenting with [photoreal 3D performance capture](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/james-c-kane_nvidiagtc-activity-7501663390977830912-2hLn) with 1-4 cameras for games and edutainment!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } Beelze Pub was updated to its final version! [Give it a play on itch.io](https://renhetstudio.itch.io/beelze-pub)!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates }  Primordio [Season One Launch Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JNaoyebzlJg) is live on YouTube!

{ 🎮 Game Releases } _Graphite Lab_ launched [Smithsonian: Digging for Dinosaurs](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/mattraithel_smithsonian-digging-for-dinosaurs-for-nintendo-share-7496258647107252224-OAFp/?rcm=ACoAAA-Ha_QB8CLbKk6H1px8GKvBtVVEzIQRf1w)! A interactive adventure where young explorers excavate fossils, discover prehistoric creatures, and learn through play in a safe, engaging experience designed for curious kids.
{ 🎼 Music Releases } _Dorian Kavadlo_ posted [_Circuit Breaker_ from Mixtape Match](https://soundcloud.com/dorian_kavadlo/circuit-breaker) on Soundcloud!
{ 🎼 Music Releases } _azetrom_ posted [their own songs from Mixtape Match](https://soundcloud.com/nese0/sets/mixtape-match) on Soundcloud as well!

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Larger Than Average Games_ showcased [Guild Legends](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4946840/Guild_Legends/) at the Share & Play! A nostalgic, heartfelt, and chaotic action game for up to four players. Build your guild, recruit diverse heroes, and slay hordes of monsters!

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _jackachulian_ showcased [Which Witch?](https://jackachulian.itch.io/which-witch) at the Share & Play! Which Witch? is a rhythm game + dating simulator where your conversations influence the music and the notes.

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Butterscotch Shenanigans'_ [How Many Dudes](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934270/How_Many_Dudes/) has past [100,000 Steam sales](https://bsky.app/profile/bscotch.net/post/3ms25ywljt22i)!
{ 🎼 Music Releases } _Fat Bard_'s music on Demon Tides is [now available on record](https://bsky.app/profile/lostincult.co.uk/post/3msit6gzp4e24) for pre-order with a limited 300 units to grab!

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Goofy Gourd Studios_ is working on [converting more NPCs for cutscene backgrounds](https://bsky.app/profile/goofygourds.bsky.social/post/3mshb57y7vs2a) and [improving the background UI](https://bsky.app/profile/goofygourds.bsky.social/post/3mtkhwncqpk2s) for their latest game!

{ 🎼 Music Releases } Listen to a compilation of video game music from our community on [STLGameDev's YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0_wfBnL3MjA)! Great for jamming out to while working on games 🕺

{ 🎼 Music Releases } _Fat Bard_ worked on the music for [Warfare 1776](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4746630/Warfare_1776/)! [Check out the new trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZQSf3GT5wFw)!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Aaron Sumner_ has been making [scenes for an office](https://bsky.app/profile/ruralocity.bsky.social/post/3musumzw4sk2o) on pico8!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Axol Studio_ has put out a [survey with a couple of questions](https://bsky.app/profile/axolstudio.com/post/3muk6ymk2za2y) for research on their next game!

{ 🎮 Game Releases } _Midnight Launch Games'_ [Time To Rogue](https://midnightlaunchgames.com/games/timetorogue/), a dungeon crawler where the resource isn't mana or gold, it's real-world time, is now out on iOS and Apple Watch!

{ 📢 Announcements } Are you ready for Spooky Season? Well prepare yourself! _STLGameDev_ is having a [**Spooky Jam**](https://itch.io/jam/stlgamedev-spooky-jam-2026) October 1st - 18th! Gather your team and get ready to make some spooky games! More details soon...

{ 📢 Announcements } Some of the _STLGameDev crew_ will be representing at [CIGS](https://www.indiecitygames.org/calendar/cigs-2026) (Chicago Indie Games Showcase) on September 13th! If you will be there, stop by to say hi and play some of the games from our community members!

events.title: September Game Audio Club - Project Share
events.description:
If you’re into making video game music or sound design (or just curious) come hang out with us once a month! Doesn’t matter if you’re a pro or just starting out— everyone’s welcome. Just bring your love for game audio. Chill time where you can share your work, get feedback, or just vibe with people who love game audio.
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316130904
events.location: St. Louis County Library - Clark Family Branch, 1640 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63131, USA
